readme.markdown:
**Open-source Rust coding agent for your terminal. Any model, multi-agent fleets, OS sandboxing, and verifiable receipts.** ```bash curl -fsSL https://codewhale.net/install.sh | sh ``` [![Latest release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/codewhale-hq/Codewhale?label=release)](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/Codewhale/releases/latest) [![CI](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/Codewhale/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/Codewhale/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![crates.io](https://img.shields.io/crates/v/codewhale-cli?label=crates.io)](https://crates.io/crates/codewhale-cli) [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/codewhale?label=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/codewhale) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue)](LICENSE) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-join-5865F2?logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/37gfS3ksug) [Website](https://codewhale.net) · [Documentation](docs/README.md) · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md) · [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md) [简体中文](docs/i18n/README.zh-CN.md) · [日本語](docs/i18n/README.ja-JP.md) · [Tiếng Việt](docs/i18n/README.vi.md) · [Bahasa Indonesia](docs/i18n/README.id.md) · [한국어](docs/i18n/README.ko-KR.md) · [Español](docs/i18n/README.es-419.md) · [Português](docs/i18n/README.pt-BR.md) · [Русский](docs/i18n/README.ru.md) · [Українська](docs/i18n/README.uk.md) · [Français](docs/i18n/README.fr.md) · [Deutsch](docs/i18n/README.de.md) · [繁體中文](docs/i18n/README.zh-TW.md) · [हिन्दी](docs/i18n/README.hi.md) · [Türkçe](docs/i18n/README.tr.md) · [Italiano](docs/i18n/README.it.md) · [Polski](docs/i18n/README.pl.md) · [العربية](docs/i18n/README.ar.md) · [Català](docs/i18n/README.ca.md) Real session on published Codewhale v0.10.4 (48669ad108fa) running local Ollama (qwen3:4b) in Accept Edits mode.
## Install The install script above puts checksum-verified `codewhale` and its short alias `codew` in `~/.local/bin` on macOS and Linux. If your shell reports `command not found`, add `~/.local/bin` to your `PATH` ([details](docs/INSTALL.md#put-it-on-your-path)). Upgrade in place with `codewhale update`. ```bash winget install --id HunterBown.CodeWhale --exact --source winget # Windows x64 npm install -g codewhale # wraps the same release binaries cargo install codewhale-cli --locked # builds from source; can trail GitHub Releases ``` Prebuilt binaries ship for Linux, macOS, and Windows (x64 and arm64). Scoop, Nix, Homebrew on Linux, Android/Termux (preview), and manual downloads are in [docs/INSTALL.md](docs/INSTALL.md); container images are in [docs/DOCKER.md](docs/DOCKER.md). Use one install method per machine so two binaries do not shadow each other on `PATH`. ## Quickstart 1. Commit or stash your work, then run `codewhale` from a git repository root. 2. Run `/provider` (or press `F3`) to select a provider, paste an API key, and pick a model. DeepSeek is the default; if no key is configured and a local Ollama server responds, Codewhale offers its models on your first message. 3. Give it a task: ```text Fix the failing tests and explain what changed. ``` Read-only commands run immediately, except in Ask, which asks before every command. Mutating shell commands prompt for approval: `y` runs once, `a` allows matching commands for the rest of the session, and `n` denies. Run `/undo` to revert the last turn and its file edits, or `/help` for commands and keybindings. ## Capabilities - **50+ built-in providers and local models:** Anthropic, OpenAI, DeepSeek (`deepseek-flash` / V4.1 Flash by default; [details](docs/PROVIDERS.md#deepseek-v41-flash)), Google, Mistral, Moonshot, OpenRouter, xAI, any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, and local runtimes via Ollama, vLLM, or SGLang. Switch models mid-session with `/model`, route per-turn with `/model auto` (`/router`), and inspect latency and cost with `/turn inspect`. See [Providers](docs/PROVIDERS.md). - **Receipts and rollback:** `/receipts` (or `codewhale receipts --last` after exiting) records changed files, commands, web/MCP calls, sub-agents, approvals, and failures. `/undo` reverts the last turn in one step; `/restore` rolls the workspace back to an earlier snapshot (requires `/trust on` or Full Access). See [Receipts](docs/RECEIPTS.md). - **Sub-agents, Fleets, and workflows:** Carry multi-turn objectives with `/goal`, delegate work to [sub-agents](docs/SUBAGENTS.md), coordinate role- and model-specific [Fleets](docs/FLEET.md), or run repository-checked [workflows](docs/WORKFLOW_AUTHORING.md). - **MCP, skills, hooks, and plugins:** Attach [MCP servers](docs/MCP.md), [skills](docs/SKILLS.md), [plugins](docs/PLUGINS.md), and lifecycle [hooks](docs/HOOKS.md). Experimental code mode (`execute_tools`) batches multiple MCP/plugin calls under your normal approval rules. Optional macOS [Computer Use](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/codewhale-cu-plugin) stays off until explicitly reviewed and enabled. - **Drop-in compatibility:** Reads `AGENTS.md` automatically. Opt into `CLAUDE.md`, `.cursorrules`, or `.github/copilot-instructions.md` via `project_instruction_imports` in [config.example.toml](config.example.toml). Import Claude Code settings and MCP servers with `/import-claude`, or install Claude Code plugins (skills, commands, agent profiles, MCP) and DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugins with `/plugin install` ([details](docs/CLAUDE_PLUGIN_COMPAT.md)). ## Entry points | Command | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `codewhale` | Interactive terminal app | | `codewhale exec "…"` | Headless single-task runner for scripts and CI ([guide](docs/INSTALL.md#headless-scripts-ci); `--auto` uses Full Access unless sandboxed) | | `codewhale web` | Local web client on `127.0.0.1` ([guide](docs/WEB.md)) | | `codewhale review --pr N` | Advisory GitHub PR review; [GitHub bot setup](docs/GITHUB_ACTION.md#set-up-your-own-bot) runs it on your own key | | `codewhale app-server --http` | Local HTTP [Runtime API](docs/RUNTIME_API.md) for threads, events, approvals, and per-turn diffs | | `codewhale serve --acp` | Agent Client Protocol over stdio for editors such as Zed | All entry points share one Rust engine ([architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)). A community-maintained [VS Code extension](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=HengQuWorld.brotherwhale-vscode) ([source](https://github.com/HengQuWorld/CodeWhale-VSCode)) connects to the same engine. See the [latest release notes](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/Codewhale/releases/latest) and [roadmap](docs/ROADMAP.md) for current release and desktop/cloud status. ## Permissions, sandboxing, and privacy `Shift+Tab` cycles permission modes: **Ask → Accept Edits → Plan → Auto-Review → Full Access** (`Tab` only completes). **Accept Edits** (default) applies edits inside the git repository and asks before commands. **Ask** prompts on every edit and command. **Plan** is read-only. **Auto-Review** uses rules and a reviewer model to approve routine calls and block high-risk ones. **Full Access** skips prompts and disables the OS sandbox (repository rules and managed policy still apply). See [Modes](docs/MODES.md). In Ask, Accept Edits, and Auto-Review, commands run inside an OS sandbox where available: Seatbelt on macOS and bubblewrap on Linux (Windows has no OS sandbox yet). Sandboxed commands and terminal sessions cannot read credential paths such as `~/.ssh`, `~/.aws`, or `.env` files. Run `/preview-request` to inspect a redacted outgoing request before sending it. API keys added with `/provider` stay on your machine, and local models require no key. `/cost` and the footer track session spend when pricing is known (an unknown price is shown as unknown, never as free). Aggregate telemetry is enabled by default (version, OS, session length/outcome, built-in provider IDs, bundled public-catalog model IDs (custom, private, or local models map to `other`), aggregate token totals, built-in tool call/error counts, and feature/error counters; rotating 90-day random install ID; never code, prompts, conversations, custom/private model names, file/repo/branch names, credentials, or IP addresses). Disable it with: ```bash codewhale config set telemetry false ``` At startup Codewhale also checks GitHub for a new release (`CODEWHALE_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1` to skip) and refreshes the public `models.dev` model catalog every 24 hours (`CODEWHALE_DISABLE_MODELS_DEV_FETCH=1` or `[catalog] auto_refresh = false` to skip; suppressed automatically in CI and under `DO_NOT_TRACK`). Details: [authorization order](docs/AUTHORIZATION_ORDER.md), [sandboxing](docs/SANDBOX.md), and [telemetry](docs/TELEMETRY.md). ## Documentation Guides follow `main` and may describe changes not yet in the latest release. | Start here | Reference | | --- | --- | | [User guide](docs/GUIDE.md) | [Configuration](docs/CONFIGURATION.md) | | [Installation](docs/INSTALL.md) | [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) | | [Providers and local models](docs/PROVIDERS.md) | [Runtime API](docs/RUNTIME_API.md) | | [Modes and permissions](docs/MODES.md) | [Plugin authoring](docs/PLUGIN_AUTHORING.md) | | [Keybindings](docs/KEYBINDINGS.md) | [Receipts](docs/RECEIPTS.md) | | [GitHub pull request review](docs/GITHUB_ACTION.md) | [All documentation](docs/README.md) | ## Contributing and license The [contributor wall](docs/CONTRIBUTORS.md) (`scripts/contributor-wall.py`) tracks code, co-authored commits, carried-forward PRs, and credited reports. Bug reports and feature proposals go to [Issues](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/Codewhale/issues/new/choose), questions to [Discussions](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/Codewhale/discussions), and PR guidelines plus layout are in [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) ([project structure](CONTRIBUTING.md#project-structure)). Join us on [Discord](https://discord.gg/37gfS3ksug) or add `hunterbown` on WeChat for the Whale Brothers group. Codewhale started as `deepseek-tui` and remains backward-compatible with its config and sessions. It is independently maintained and not affiliated with DeepSeek or any other model provider.
